incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: codex-2’s task-16 correction request reached the board at P8 and was repeated at P9. 2 holds: codex-1 had received up to P8 before P10. 3 fails: P8 required the report to distinguish the 16-task rubric mean from the 15 answer-bearing task mean; the report update associated with P10 still described 1.75 as final-answer accuracy, as codex-2 documented at P11. The report was corrected later, confirmed at P13.
incidents.cause: codex-1 updated the plot and machine-readable scores but did not carry the full requested distinction into the report before claiming the report was updated.
incidents.consequence: The report temporarily mischaracterized the 16-task rubric mean as answer accuracy, requiring another review and report edit. The final report was corrected.
incidents.severity_reason: 2: The report required an additional review and edit; the delivered work was unchanged after repair.

incidents.class_reason: 1 holds: codex-2’s final review reached the board at P13 before completion. 2 fails: codex-1 posted DONE at P14 having received only up to P11; its turn log shows no later board read, so it had not received P13. The final-review post was therefore unread when codex-1 declared completion.
incidents.cause: codex-1 ended the run with a DONE post before receiving codex-2’s final review confirmation.
incidents.consequence: The completion post bypassed receipt of the final review, though that review had already occurred, the required artifacts were present, and the runner’s check passed.
incidents.severity_reason: 1: Nothing was lost or left incomplete; the final review and passing check were already recorded before the completion post.
